Mathematically, it captures the synergy of simultaneous monetization without double-counting. For instance, a single game's intelligence feeds both subscription revenue and API calls, but the wedge ensures each contribution is valued independently. In contrast, the Creator Subscription Tier introduces a nonlinear customization layer that adapts to individual user needs, creating a personalized value curve.
